subject.title: Windows QuickStart defaults first chat to paid Anthropic model without credit warning

question: For Anthropic API-key/setup-token QuickStart, should OpenClaw change the first-run default model, add a pre-hatch paid-credit warning, or do both?
rationale: The source-level problem is clear, but choosing the default model and billing-warning policy affects provider positioning, setup UX, and existing expectations around Anthropic Opus defaults.

options.title: Warn and use safer first-run default
options.body: Prefer a lower-risk Anthropic first-run default where provider owners approve and show an explicit billing/credit warning before terminal hatch.

options.title: Keep Opus but require confirmation
options.body: Keep the current Opus default but require an explicit pre-hatch paid-credit confirmation and clearer first-chat billing recovery copy.

options.title: Document intentional Opus behavior
options.body: Treat Opus-by-default as intentional and close only after docs and onboarding copy make the paid-credit requirement unmistakable.

recommendation.title: Warn and use safer first-run default
recommendation.body: Prefer a lower-risk Anthropic first-run default where provider owners approve and show an explicit billing/credit warning before terminal hatch.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest recent history across Anthropic default policy, Claude CLI onboarding, and provider billing display work.
